title: Tenda firmware (multiple versions) contains hidden authentication backdoor
summary: Security researchers discovered hidden authentication backdoors in multiple versions of Tenda router firmware, allowing unauthorized remote access to affected devices.
problem_solved: Documents a critical security vulnerability where Tenda firmware contains undocumented backdoor authentication mechanisms that could be exploited by attackers.
why_valuable: This vulnerability disclosure helps security researchers and device owners identify and patch dangerous backdoors that could give attackers full control of affected network devices.
